source.author_bird_state_dataset: LaRue et al 2024 original pinned EMPE_Global satellite XLSX

selection.pre_image_end_rule: 15-day composite start + 14 days must be strictly before original dated bird image
selection.grid: EPSG:3412, verified 1km coordinates with independently stored 2D latitude/longitude
selection.monitor: class4 interior count and percentage, edges5/6 separately; paired centers; count available preimage composites and class4 persistence

frozen_prior_observed_outcomes.2011: author no birds with available ice; physical class4 fraction 0 at both centers in preceding map
frozen_prior_observed_outcomes.2014: author no birds with available ice; primary class4 0/28 vs secondary 30/30 in preceding map

inference_boundaries: This is NOT confirmatory: event dates and author biological outcomes were already read before physical raster extraction
Original source annotations and the independent MODIS ice classification have different dates, image resolutions and uncertainty
No exact annual breeding footprint or nesting success is supplied
An image class4 location is not automatically physically usable throughout egg/chick season
2013 November is not stage-matched with October and cannot be pooled as equal timing
Do not select between two published centroids post hoc; report both even if ecological narrative weakens
Do not infer social fidelity, immigrant movement, recruitment, colonization or social inhibition
